banter_1: Things are going really well for you. Lend me some money?
chatter1_1: Quiet night at the table. Those are my favourite.
chatter1_2: Eight decks, shuffled fresh every round. Every hand starts from nothing.
chatter1_3: I've dealt a lot of hands at this table. No two ever play out the same.
chatter2_1: Take your time. The cards aren't going anywhere.
chatter2_2: No rush at all. Think it over.
chatter2_3: Whenever you're ready. The decision is yours.
dealerblackjack_1: Dealer has blackjack. I'm sorry, everyone.
dealerblackjack_2: Blackjack for the house this time. It happens to the best of us.
dealerblackjack_3: I'm afraid it's blackjack for me. That round goes to the house.
dealerbust_1: Dealer busts! Everyone still in the hand gets paid.
dealerbust_2: Too many for me. The house busts. Congratulations, table.
dealerbust_3: And that's over twenty-one for the dealer. Winners all round.
double_1: Doubling down. One card, and one card only.
double_2: Double it is. Here's your one card.
double_3: Doubled. One card to settle it.
farewell_1: Thank you for playing. It was a pleasure dealing for you.
farewell_2: All done for tonight? Thank you, it was lovely having you at the table.
farewell_3: Good night, and thank you for the company at my table.
goodluck_1: No more bets. Here come the cards.
goodluck_2: Bets are closed. Good luck, everyone.
goodluck_3: That's all the bets. Let's see what the shoe has for us.
greet_axel: Axel, welcome to the table. Good to see you.
greet_emil: Emil, welcome back to the table.
greet_fredrik: Fredrik, welcome. Good to have you here.
greet_guest: Welcome to the table. Take a seat, and good luck.
greet_jakob: Jakob, welcome to the table. Take a seat.
greet_kevin: Kevin, welcome back. Your seat is waiting.
greeting_1: Good evening, and welcome to the table. I'm Mårten, take any seat you like.
greeting_2: Welcome in. Pull up a chair, the cards are fresh and the table is yours.
greeting_3: A new face at the table. Welcome, I'm Mårten, and I'll be dealing for you tonight.
insurance_1: Ace showing. Would anyone like insurance?
insurance_2: I have an ace. Insurance is open, and it pays two to one.
insurance_3: Ace up, so insurance is on offer. Entirely your call.
lose_1: Dealer wins. That one goes to the house.
lose_2: Not this time, I'm afraid. The house holds.
lose_3: Close, but the house has it this round.
peek_1: One moment while I check for blackjack.
peek_3: Checking for blackjack. Nothing up my sleeve.
placebets_1: Bets are open. Place your chips whenever you're ready.
placebets_2: New round, fresh cards. The betting circle is all yours.
placebets_3: The table is open. Take your time, and place your bets.
push_1: Same total. It's a push, your stake stays with you.
push_2: We're level. A push, nobody wins and nobody loses.
remark_hit17_1: Seventeen, and you still want more? Bold.
remark_hit17_2: Another card on seventeen. Let's see.
remark_hit20_1: Hitting on twenty? That is a brave one.
remark_stand11_1: Standing on eleven? You can't bust with one more card.
sidebet_1: Your side bet comes in. That one pays straight away.
sidebet_2: Side bet's a winner. Nice way to start the hand.
sidebet_3: And the side bet lands. Paid before we've even begun.
table_cash_1: Everyone looks after themselves, and the cash, first.
table_trust_1: You can't trust anyone in this game.
